نبذة

In Jumeirah Golf Estates, mea is a boutique salon where luxury meets warmth. Our team is handpicked for their expertise — from Master Colourists and technically skilled hairdressers to flawless nail artists and experienced beauty professionals. Every service is delivered with care, precision, and meticulous attention to detail, using only quality products. From bespoke facials to tailor-made wellness rituals, every element of your visit is thoughtfully considered to leave you feeling truly cared for. Enjoy handcrafted coffee, iced options, and more.
